typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	dPrevcalNoTime as timestamp (toTimestamp('1/27/2026')),
	sStartTime as timestamp (toTimestamp('1/28/2026 9:44:32 AM')),
	tblCLYFXCURRENCYCONVERSION_outputfilename as string (),
	tblCLYFXCURRENCYCONVERSIONHIST_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		QUOTE_DATE as timestamp,
		SRCE_CCY as string,
		CNVRT_TO as string,
		CLOSE_QUOTE as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(QUOTE_DATE_SQL = QUOTE_DATE,
		CNVRT_TO_SQL = CNVRT_TO,
		SRCE_CCY_SQL = SRCE_CCY,
		CLOSE_QUOTE_SQL = CLOSE_QUOTE) ~> DataConversion
OLEDBSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DataConversion derive(dCreateDate = $sStartTime,
		dCalcQuoteDate = $dPrevcalNoTime) ~> DerivedColumn
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Create_Dte as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SRCE_CURR as string,
		CLOSE_QUOTE as double,
		Quote_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CNVRT_TO as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Create_Dte = dCreateDate,
		SRCE_CURR = SRCE_CCY_SQL,
		CLOSE_QUOTE = CLOSE_QUOTE_SQL,
		Quote_Date = dCalcQuoteDate,
		CNVRT_TO = CNVRT_TO_SQL),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblCLYFXCURRENCYCONVERSION_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblCLYFXCURRENCYCONVERSION
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Create_Dte as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLOSE_QUOTE as double,
		SRCE_CURR as string,
		Quote_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CNVRT_TO as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Create_Dte = dCreateDate,
		CLOSE_QUOTE = CLOSE_QUOTE_SQL,
		SRCE_CURR = SRCE_CCY_SQL,
		Quote_Date = dCalcQuoteDate,
		CNVRT_TO = CNVRT_TO_SQL),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblCLYFXCURRENCYCONVERSIONHIST_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblCLYFXCURRENCYCONVERSIONHIST
